description: This file contains shell functions and routines to support the creation and manipulation of pack files, including packing headers, pack objects, and related utilities for handling pack data, deltas, and trailers. It appears to be part of a version control or packfile generation utility.

methods.name: uint32_octal
methods.description: Prints the big-endian 4-byte octal representation of a given number.

methods.name: uint32_binary
methods.description: Prints the big-endian 4-byte binary representation of a given number.

methods.name: pack_header
methods.description: Prints a pack header with specified number of objects, version 2.

methods.name: pack_obj
methods.description: Outputs the pack data for an object, possibly as a delta against another object, with hardcoded cases for specific known objects.

methods.name: pack_trailer
methods.description: Computes and appends the pack trailer to a file.

methods.name: clear_packs
methods.description: Removes any existing pack files to ensure subsequent pack creation uses fresh data.
